newsitem.title: ESTONIA: NORMA TO LAUNCH SECURITIES SUBSIDIARY.
newsitem.headline: NORMA TO LAUNCH SECURITIES SUBSIDIARY.

text.p: Norma Group, which owns industrial firm Norma, hopes to launch a securities subsidiary, which it wants to become a member of the stock exchange, early in the summer, the company said on Friday.
"We will soon present the documents to the business register and hope to start in two months or early summer," Andres Jarving, vice chairman of Norma Group, told Reuters.
The subsidiary will become the manager of the group's securities portfolio, now managed by other brokers, and will carry out general asset management business.
"It is obligatory to become a member of the stock exchange," he added.
Jarving said Norma Group will not increase by much its securities after the launch of its subsidiary.
Norma Group also wants to add new instruments to its portfolio and increase its share of Latvian and Lithuanian shares and bonds, Jarving said.
The share capital of the subsidiary will be 400.000 kroons, Jarving said.
Norma Group board will probably approve the business plan and other details of the subsidiary on Monday, he added.
